Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 1
Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly identified the time when a shadow is shortest. A shadow is shortest when the sun is at its highest point in the sky (solar noon), not when its heating effect is maximal (which occurs later due to thermal inertia). Furthermore, the Planner confused the logic by suggesting solar noon shifts to 1:00 PM due to Daylight Saving Time, yet concluded that 4:05 PM (which is 3 hours after 1:00 PM) would be the time of the shortest shadow. In reality, 12:05 PM (Option B) is closest to solar noon and would produce the shortest shadow, making Option C the wrong answer derived from this fundamental physical error.
